title: Products are ok, the company is not.
text: Products range from cheap to passable, but there weren't enough decent items to keep paying. They also seem to have poor quality control as one of the ties I received was damaged on arrival.  Once I tried to cancel I realized how sleazy the company is.  You can't cancel online, you have to call their customer service number during business hours to get your subscription cancelled.  Even then you have to listen to their shtick and jump through hoops that would make a cable company proud. Online reviews and even their site says you can cancel at anytime, but that's not true and it's not easy.
label: negative
